passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.1
passages.text: Haec tua Penelope lento tibi mittit, Ulixe;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.2
passages.text: Nil mihi rescribas attinet: ipse veni!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.3
passages.text: Troia iacet certe, Danais invisa puellis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.4
passages.text: Vix Priamus tanti totaque Troia fuit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.5
passages.text: O utinam tum, cum Lacedaemona classe petebat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.6
passages.text: Obrutus insanis esset adulter aquis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.7
passages.text: Non ego deserto iacuissem frigida lecto,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.8
passages.text: Nec quererer tardos ire relicta dies;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.9
passages.text: Nec mihi quaerenti spatiosam fallere noctem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.10
passages.text: Lassaret viduas pendula tela manus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.11
passages.text: Quando ego non timui graviora pericula veris?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.12
passages.text: Res est solliciti plena timoris amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.13
passages.text: In te fingebam violentos Troas ituros;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.14
passages.text: Nomine in Hectoreo pallida semper eram.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.15
passages.text: Sive quis Antilochum narrabat ab hoste revictum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.16
passages.text: Antilochus nostri causa timoris erat;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.17
passages.text: Sive Menoetiaden falsis cecidisse sub armis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.18
passages.text: Flebam successu posse carere dolos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.19
passages.text: Sanguine Tlepolemus Lyciam tepefecerat hastam;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.20
passages.text: Tlepolemi leto cura novata mea est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.21
passages.text: Denique, quisquis erat castris iugulatus Achivis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.22
passages.text: Frigidius glacie pectus amantis erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.23
passages.text: Sed bene consuluit casto deus aequus amori.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.24
passages.text: Versa est in cineres sospite Troia viro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.25
passages.text: Argolici rediere duces, altaria fumant;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.26
passages.text: Ponitur ad patrios barbara praeda deos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.27
passages.text: Grata ferunt nymphae pro salvis dona maritis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.28
passages.text: Illi victa suis Troica fata canunt.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.29
passages.text: Mirantur iustique senes trepidaeque puellae;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.30
passages.text: Narrantis coniunx pendet ab ore viri.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.31
passages.text: Atque aliquis posita monstrat fera proelia mensa,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.32
passages.text: Pingit et exiguo Pergama tota mero:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.33
passages.text: 'Hac ibat Simois; haec est Sigeia tellus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.34
passages.text: Hic steterat Priami regia celsa senis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.35
passages.text: Illic Aeacides, illic tendebat Ulixes;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.36
passages.text: Hic lacer admissos terruit Hector equos.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.37
passages.text: Omnia namque tuo senior te quaerere misso

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.38
passages.text: Rettulerat nato Nestor, at ille mihi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.39
passages.text: Rettulit et ferro Rhesumque Dolonaque caesos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.40
passages.text: Utque sit hic somno proditus, ille dolo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.41
passages.text: Ausus es — o nimium nimiumque oblite tuorum! —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.42
passages.text: Thracia nocturno tangere castra dolo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.43
passages.text: Totque simul mactare viros, adiutus ab uno!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.44
passages.text: At bene cautus eras et memor ante mei!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.45
passages.text: Usque metu micuere sinus, dum victor amicum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.46
passages.text: Dictus es Ismariis isse per agmen equis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.47
passages.text: Sed mihi quid prodest vestris disiecta lacertis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.48
passages.text: Ilios et, murus quod fuit, esse solum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.49
passages.text: Si maneo, qualis Troia durante manebam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.50
passages.text: Virque mihi dempto fine carendus abest?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.51
passages.text: Diruta sunt aliis, uni mihi Pergama restant,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.52
passages.text: Incola captivo quae bove victor arat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.53
passages.text: Iam seges est, ubi Troia fuit, resecandaque falce

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.54
passages.text: Luxuriat Phrygio sanguine pinguis humus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.55
passages.text: Semisepulta virum curvis feriuntur aratris

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.56
passages.text: Ossa, ruinosas occulit herba domos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.57
passages.text: Victor abes, nec scire mihi, quae causa morandi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.58
passages.text: Aut in quo lateas ferreus orbe, licet!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.59
passages.text: Quisquis ad haec vertit peregrinam litora puppim,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.60
passages.text: Ille mihi de te multa rogatus abit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.61
passages.text: Quamque tibi reddat, si te modo viderit usquam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.62
passages.text: Traditur huic digitis charta notata meis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.63
passages.text: Nos Pylon, antiqui Neleia Nestoris arva,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.64
passages.text: Misimus; incerta est fama remissa Pylo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.65
passages.text: Misimus et Sparten; Sparte quoque nescia veri.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.66
passages.text: Quas habitas terras, aut ubi lentus abes?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.67
passages.text: Utilius starent etiamnunc moenia Phoebi —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.68
passages.text: Irascor votis, heu, levis ipsa meis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.69
passages.text: Scirem ubi pugnares, et tantum bella timerem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.70
passages.text: Et mea cum multis iuncta querela foret.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.71
passages.text: Quid timeam, ignoro — timeo tamen omnia demens,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.72
passages.text: Et patet in curas area lata meas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.73
passages.text: Quaecumque aequor habet, quaecumque pericula tellus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.74
passages.text: Tam longae causas suspicor esse morae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.75
passages.text: Haec ego dum stulte metuo, quae vestra libido est,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.76
passages.text: Esse peregrino captus amore potes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.77
passages.text: Forsitan et narres, quam sit tibi rustica coniunx,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.78
passages.text: Quae tantum lanas non sinat esse rudes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.79
passages.text: Fallar, et hoc crimen tenues vanescat in auras,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.80
passages.text: Neve, revertendi liber, abesse velis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.81
passages.text: Me pater Icarius viduo discedere lecto

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.82
passages.text: Cogit et immensas increpat usque moras.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.83
passages.text: Increpet usque licet — tua sum, tua dicar oportet;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.84
passages.text: Penelope coniunx semper Ulixis ero.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.85
passages.text: Ille tamen pietate mea precibusque pudicis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.86
passages.text: Frangitur et vires temperat ipse suas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.87
passages.text: Dulichii Samiique et quos tulit alta Zacynthos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.88
passages.text: Turba ruunt in me luxuriosa proci,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.89
passages.text: Inque tua regnant nullis prohibentibus aula;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.90
passages.text: Viscera nostra, tuae dilacerantur opes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.91
passages.text: Quid tibi Pisandrum Polybumque Medontaque dirum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.92
passages.text: Eurymachique avidas Antinoique manus

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.93
passages.text: Atque alios referam, quos omnis turpiter absens

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.94
passages.text: Ipse tuo partis sanguine rebus alis?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.95
passages.text: Irus egens pecorisque Melanthius actor edendi

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.96
passages.text: Ultimus accedunt in tua damna pudor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.97
passages.text: Tres sumus inbelles numero, sine viribus uxor

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.98
passages.text: Laertesque senex Telemachusque puer.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.99
passages.text: Ille per insidias paene est mihi nuper ademptus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.100
passages.text: Dum parat invitis omnibus ire Pylon.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.101
passages.text: Di, precor, hoc iubeant, ut euntibus ordine fatis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.102
passages.text: Ille meos oculos conprimat, ille tuos!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.103
passages.text: Hac faciunt custosque boum longaevaque nutrix,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.104
passages.text: Tertius inmundae cura fidelis harae;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.105
passages.text: Sed neque Laertes, ut qui sit inutilis armis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.106
passages.text: Hostibus in mediis regna tenere potest —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.107
passages.text: Telemacho veniet, vivat modo, fortior aetas;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.108
passages.text: Nunc erat auxiliis illa tuenda patris —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.109
passages.text: Nec mihi sunt vires inimicos pellere tectis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.110
passages.text: Tu citius venias, portus et ara tuis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.111
passages.text: Est tibi sitque, precor, natus, qui mollibus annis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.112
passages.text: In patrias artes erudiendus erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.113
passages.text: Respice Laerten; ut tu sua lumina condas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.114
passages.text: Extremum fati sustinet ille diem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.115
passages.text: Certe ego, quae fueram te discedente puella,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 1.116
passages.text: Protinus ut venias, facta videbor anus.
